title: Use addTearDown(container.dispose) in pin_flow_controller_test.dart's async/setup-transition tests
why: Every other group in this file creates its container with addTearDown(container.dispose) immediately after construction, per TQ-2, guaranteeing cleanup even when an expect() throws. The 5 tests in the 'verify mode (async)' and 'setup mode step transitions' groups (lines ~424-435, 442-454, 463-474, 579-599, 604-625) instead call container.dispose() as the last statement in the test body — if any expect() before it fails, the container and its pending bcrypt/timer callbacks leak into the rest of the suite.
recommendation: Add addTearDown(container.dispose) immediately after each of the 5 `final container = _makeContainer(...)` calls in these two groups; drop the trailing manual container.dispose() calls.
acceptance_criteria: No test in the file calls container.dispose() as its last statement; every container has a paired addTearDown at construction.
